item.text: {"analysis":"Trial failed source validation with invalid syntax at line 428; allocated GPU time was 0.0 seconds and no validation score was produced. Unresolved patch markers (>>>>>>> REPLACE, <<<<<<< SEARCH, =======) corrupted the metrics-writing block. The tail also references undefined `references`. Training, first-step diagnostics, and predictor parity checks never executed. Consequently, this trial provides no evidence for or against sampled listwise cross-entropy. The supplied 0.4012 pooling, 0.505 SASRec, and 0.4100 sequential-context scores are historical references, not measurements from this trial. Repair the source tail before rerunning the controlled objective experiment.","code_summary":"One independent HistoryModel per category, with exactly one selected checkpoint loaded for prediction. The unchanged network uses separate input/output item embeddings, last-item and mean-history features, two learned attention-pooling heads with recency decay, an MLP residual encoder, LayerNorm, normalized dot-product scoring, learned scale, and item bias. Intended objective: sampled cross-entropy with the positive at class zero and 64 uniform negative draws, masking target/prefix matches while preserving duplicate draws. AdamW, sampling, validation schedule, category routing, and the 200-epoch default were preserved. Generated prediction code reconstructs the same architecture from train.py and loads the category checkpoint; no ensemble is implemented."}
